note: Commercially the strongest ICP match in the corpus and clinically outside it. Successful and income are emphatic: a partner in a private equity firm owning nine companies with about a thousand employees, who agreed to $6,000 within seconds and never asked for a payment plan. Not_deconditioned is equally clear — a former Division I tennis player who had already started kettlebell training on his own and knows his way around a gym. He misses on the two criteria that describe the starting point. Neglected_health does not fit a man with four to five years of progressively worsening spinal pain, disc desiccation on imaging, a prior herniated disc, diagnosed narcolepsy managed on daily Adderall, and an exhausted list of failed clinical modalities; that is a managed chronic condition, not a deprioritised area. Good_to_great does not fit either — his own framing is recovery, not elevation: 'get back to at least a version of how I used to look' and 'I feel kind of like a weak, soft.' This is the third call in this batch, after Steve Dawson and to a lesser extent Chris Wiley, where the buyer is commercially ideal and clinically complicated, which sharpens the observation already recorded in icp.json that the stated ICP has no clinical criterion. Here that gap did not lose a deal, as it did with Tyron Giuliani — it closed one at full price with no clearance question asked.
